findings.headline: Migrate this equalFn reference to its Solid 2 replacement.
findings.why: Solid 2 renames equalFn to isEqual with the same (a, b) => boolean signature.
findings.guidance: Replace every reference to equalFn with isEqual. No other changes are required — the signature is identical.

findings.headline: Remove this writeSignal call.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes writeSignal; batching is now default — use the normal setter.
findings.guidance: Remove this call. Replace with the signal's normal setter; updates are batched automatically.

findings.headline: Remove this enableScheduling call.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes enableScheduling; the global scheduler no longer exists.
findings.guidance: Remove this call. Solid 2 has no global scheduler toggle.
